name: New Apocalypse
caption: A heel stable of four wrestlers who swept the SEWF Championship tournament's opening round on 2 October and confronted Simon Solkoff the same night.

tenures.source: The EWWF's own 2 October 2002 Surrender broadcast (/promotions/ewwf-surrender-2002/archive/surrender-2002-10-02.html).

name: The Seventh Seal
caption: A tag team, Anatoly Kosygin and Minh-Dao Tung, brought into the EWWF by Nick Demola; won their debut match and helped take the Tag Team Championship the same night.

tenures.source: The EWWF's own 5 December 2002 Surrender broadcast (/promotions/ewwf-surrender-2002/archive/surrender-2002-12-05.html).

name: The Chain Gang
caption: A debuting tag team, Victor Garza and Markee De Sade, pinned by the Seventh Seal in their first EWWF match.

tenures.source: The EWWF's own 5 December 2002 Surrender broadcast (/promotions/ewwf-surrender-2002/archive/surrender-2002-12-05.html).

identity.note: A same-named tag team in an unrelated, much later federation (2004-05), with no surviving roster; nothing ties it to this run.
